mapper.select: select id, name, prefix, scope, created_by, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', ) created_at, to_char(last_used at time zone 'UTC', ) last_used, calls, to_char(revoked_at at time zone 'UTC', ) revoked_at from api_keys where tenant_id = #{tid} order by api_keys.created_at desc limit 50
select count(*)::int n from api_keys where tenant_id = #{tid} and revoked_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into api_keys (id, tenant_id, name, prefix, hash, scope, created_by) values (#{id}, #{tid}, #{name}, #{prefix}, #{hash}, #{scope}, #{by})
mapper.update: update api_keys set revoked_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id} and revoked_at is null
mapper.select: select k.id, k.tenant_id tid, k.name, k.scope, t.name org, t.type from api_keys k join tenants t on t.id = k.tenant_id where k.hash = #{hash} and k.revoked_at is null
mapper.update: update api_keys set last_used = now(), calls = calls + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select doc::text doc, rev from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select doc::text doc, rev from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid} for update
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = cast(#{doc} as jsonb), rev = rev + 1, bytes = #{bytes}, updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid}
